body: Audit B-48, proven on an emulator against two real stacks (6 Nov 2026): after a server is reinstalled (a new identity key) every phone says 'Another server answers at <address>' once and then 'Not reachable / No answer' on the Your server page, and the only way out is signing out, which deletes the downloads (docs/31 CN-28). Add the re-trust step to the pairing slice (the person's password, or a new pairing link) and make the page say what is true. See docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md B-48 and docs/evidence/README.md#d01.
